name: Finance Variance, 3-Way Match & AR Reconciliation
description: Reconciles AP 3-way PO/GR/Invoice matches with SAP TCURX/SHKZG guards and duplicate/bank-change fraud holds, builds constant-currency P&L variance bridges without summary double-counting, and audits AR aging buckets with strict credit-memo isolation.

skills.summary: Performs deterministic PO/GR/Invoice 3-way matching with SAP TCURX decimal normalization, SHKZG sign handling, duplicate invoice detection, and bank-change fraud holds.
Computes P&L Actual vs Budget/Forecast variance bridges split by constant-FX vs currency impact while enforcing leaf-vs-summary hierarchy tie-outs.
Buckets open accounts receivable across Current to 90+ days while isolating unapplied credit memos so negative rows never mask delinquent balances.

byo_mcp: SAP S/4HANA / Oracle ERP MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Pull PO, Goods Receipt, Invoice, GL actual/budget hierarchy, and AR open-item ledgers from BigQuery, Google Sheets, SharePoint, or customer SAP/Oracle ERP MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before running Python reconciliation engines.

gateway_approval_actions: Releasing AP invoice payment batches or posting GL/AP entries via customer ERP MCP
Updating vendor remittance or bank master records in ERP (never auto-executed from email)
Sending external customer AR collections or dunning emails via Gmail or Outlook
python_code_guardrails: TCURX zero/3-decimal scaling (JPY/KRW x100, KWD/BHD x0.1), SHKZG='H' sign inversion, and BEC bank-change FRAUD_HOLD
GL summary-vs-leaf exclusion preventing parent rollup double-counting beyond hierarchy_tolerance_amount
AR credit-memo isolation so negative credits never mask 90+ days past-due delinquency

scheduled_routine.name: daily-ap-grir-exception-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Daily AP & GR/IR Exception Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekday morning AP 3-way match sweep using scripts/reconcile_3way.py across open vendor invoices, purchase orders, and goods receipts. Surface duplicate invoice suspects, bank-change holds, TCURX decimal mismatches, and price/quantity exceptions for AP Controller review without releasing payments.
